title: paeonia anomala subsp. hybrida
intro: Paeonia anomala subsp. hybrida, commonly known as Rocky Mountain peony, is a plant species that belongs to the Paeonia genus and is native to the mountainous regions of North America. The roots of this plant have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and are said to have a positive effect on digestive issues and menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia anomala subsp. hybrida include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
